note: Behaviour the bus promises, independent of which engine stores it. A runner must execute every case; an engine that cannot execute a case is reported, never skipped silently.

cases.name: ordering
cases.why: records come back in the order the stream assigned

cases.name: read-is-not-destructive
cases.why: reading twice yields the same records and advances nothing

cases.name: retention-window
cases.why: records older than the window are removed

cases.name: gap-reporting
cases.why: a consumer behind the window is told what it lost

cases.name: address-round-trip
cases.why: an address keeps its exact spelling through the engine
